native.stackedNotation: Numerator above denominator with a horizontal rule in questions and cards; the literal fraction remains accessible and copyable. Source prompts, keys and saved plans are unchanged.
native.auraLayout: Mini and adult fourth-critical auras checked below the question; portrait widths reduced, all answer targets remain playable.
native.battleRegression: Normal, double, triple and fourth criticals, both directions, mistake implosion, low HP and persistent adult form; offline play, portrait fallback and landscape capability paths.
native.artGallery: Existing 480 mini casting/adult-state sprites reviewed by the battle fixture.
